parole.testo: From Old Hungarian, borrowed in the early 11ᵗʰ century from Old High German chafteri (“beehive”) – Middle High German chafter (“beehive; little chamber, closet”), German Käfter (“little chamber, closet”) –, from Medieval Latin capistērium (“beehive”), for scaphistērium, from Ancient Greek σκαφιστήρι
